name: v1.14.3
body:
## [Talos 1.14.3](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/tag/v1.14.3) (2026-10-15) Welcome to the v1.14.3 release of Talos! Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/issues. ### Time Check API The `TimeService/TimeCheck` API (`talosctl time --check`) is no longer available to the `os:reader` role, as it allows querying arbitrary time servers from the node. The `TimeService/Time` API (querying the configured time server) is still available to `os:reader`. PTP device paths are now strictly validated both in the machine configuration and in the API: the path should be directly under `/dev`, the name should start with `ptp` (e.g. `/dev/ptp0`, `/dev/ptp_kvm`), and the device should be a PTP character device. ### Component Updates Linux: 6.18.56 containerd: 2.3.7 etcd: 3.7.2 Talos is built with Go 1.26.9. ### Contributors * Andrey Smirnov * Alexander Soelberg Heidarsson * Angelos Petheriotis * Brian Cappello * Christoph Engelbert (noctarius) * Mateusz Urbanek * Noel Georgi * Oguz Kilcan * Steve Wills * frauniki ### Changes
17 commits

* siderolabs/talos@68da63f11 release(v1.14.3): prepare release * siderolabs/talos@cbe344931 fix: disable GSO offload on QEMU 10.2+ * siderolabs/talos@1e3f3ad5f test: adapt minimal settings to new QEMU version * siderolabs/talos@59e1fcd63 fix: restrict raw disk helper to linux * siderolabs/talos@08b213686 fix: make the imager installer reproducible with system extensions * siderolabs/talos@a9b984aab fix: improve KubePrism load balancer recovery * siderolabs/talos@d01538115 fix: clean up mountpoints on unmount * siderolabs/talos@146c2bd92 fix: roll back stacked try configs to the config before the first try * siderolabs/talos@f5182237e fix: correct handling of DHCP changing address * siderolabs/talos@f97d79fc3 fix: image verification test * siderolabs/talos@5fadce79d fix: verify the claim for the legacy bundle image verification * siderolabs/talos@6cade9fed fix: restore source names for pseudo filesystem mounts * siderolabs/talos@692e6796b fix: add validation for the PTP device name * siderolabs/talos@b166b72ca fix: network on azure (and might fix some other platforms) * siderolabs/talos@4c4e57a4b feat: update etcd to 3.7.2 * siderolabs/talos@0d3b40c44 feat: update tools and pkgs * siderolabs/talos@51d094f47 fix: tear down stale routes before adding their replacements

### Changes from siderolabs/pkgs
5 commits

* siderolabs/pkgs@5fa47d1 feat: update to containerd 2.3.7 * siderolabs/pkgs@6873154 feat: update Linux to 6.18.56 * siderolabs/pkgs@ecd53d0 feat: enable pNFS block and SCSI layouts in nfsd * siderolabs/pkgs@473b20c feat: enable bhyve guest support on amd64 * siderolabs/pkgs@f3add0c feat: enable Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 (QAIC) driver

### Changes from siderolabs/tools
1 commit

* siderolabs/tools@6b71647 feat: update Go to 1.26.9

### Dependency Changes * **github.com/containerd/containerd/v2** v2.3.6 -> v2.3.7 * **github.com/siderolabs/pkgs** v1.14.0-37-g6c312e4 -> v1.14.0-42-g5fa47d1 * **github.com/siderolabs/talos/pkg/machinery** v1.14.2 -> v1.14.3 * **github.com/siderolabs/tools** v1.14.0-8-g9776960 -> v1.14.0-9-g6b71647 * **go.etcd.io/etcd/api/v3** v3.7.1 -> v3.7.2 * **go.etcd.io/etcd/client/pkg/v3** v3.7.1 -> v3.7.2 * **go.etcd.io/etcd/client/v3** v3.7.1 -> v3.7.2 * **go.etcd.io/etcd/etcdutl/v3** v3.7.1 -> v3.7.2 * **golang.org/x/net** v0.58.0 -> v0.60.0 * **golang.org/x/sync** v0.22.0 -> v0.23.0 * **golang.org/x/sys** v0.47.0 -> v0.48.0 * **golang.org/x/term** v0.45.0 -> v0.46.0 * **golang.org/x/text** v0.41.0 -> v0.42.0 Previous release can be found at [v1.14.2](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/tag/v1.14.2) ## Images ``` ghcr.io/siderolabs/flannel:0.28.9 registry.k8s.io/coredns/coredns:v1.14.7 registry.k8s.io/etcd:v3.7.2 registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10.2 registry.k8s.io/kube-apiserver:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-controller-manager:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-scheduler:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-proxy:v1.37.1 ghcr.io/siderolabs/kubelet:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/networking/kube-network-policies:v1.1.2 ghcr.io/siderolabs/installer-base:v1.14.3 ghcr.io/siderolabs/imager:v1.14.3 ghcr.io/siderolabs/talos:v1.14.3 ghcr.io/siderolabs/talosctl-all:v1.14.3 ghcr.io/siderolabs/overlays:v1.14.3 ghcr.io/siderolabs/extensions:v1.14.3 ```
